title: AppCompass app manifest (v1)
description: Describes a host app to AppCompass: its screens, the actions the agent may offer, and domain rules. Platform-neutral: the same manifest works for Flutter, React Native, web or native apps.

app_id.description: Stable identifier for the app. Must match the app the API key belongs to.

version.description: Manifest version. Increment on every change.

name.description: Human-readable app name used in answers.

locales.description: Languages the agent may answer in. First entry is the default.

no_medical_advice.description: Refuse diagnosis, treatment or medication questions and point to a clinician.

handoff_contact.description: Where users are sent when the agent hands off (email, phone or URL).

extra_instructions.description: Plain-language rules specific to this app. Cannot override AppCompass safety rules.

actions.description: Actions the agent may offer as buttons. The host app executes them via its onAction callback.

description.description: What the user can do on this screen, in plain words.
When the agent should offer this action. Shown to the model as the tool description.

label.description: Default button label. The agent may produce a more specific one.

params.description: Parameter name to type. 'string', 'integer', 'boolean', or 'enum:screens' (any declared screen id).
